title: Deep neural networks point to isochlorogenic acid A as a platelet-production inducer
summary: A hybrid CNN+DNN model reached accuracy 98.3% and precision 97.0% in predicting compound activity and flagged seven FDA-approved drugs as active. Screening the Chinese Pharmacopoeia Natural Product Library led to isochlorogenic acid A, which in experiments enhanced megakaryocyte differentiation and maturation and platelet production. The evidence is cell-level; in vivo effects on radiation-induced thrombocytopenia are not shown in the abstract.
ai_technology: Hybrid convolutional plus deep neural network compound-activity model on physicochemical features
organization: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
